title: Morgan and Helen Chu Dean and Professor of Law
bio: John C.P. Goldberg is the Morgan and Helen Chu Dean and Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. Goldberg, an expert in tort law, tort theory, and political philosophy, joined the Law School faculty in 2008. He served as a Deputy Dean from 2017 to 2022 and as the Interim Dean from 2024 to 2025.
